# graycup-web

> Gray Cup is an ecommerce website selling tea, coffee, and coffee sample packs.

Gray Cup’s catalogue includes tea, single-origin and blended coffee, ground coffee, and configurable sample packs. The homepage provides product search, a “Buy via Fast” shopping route, free delivery on orders above ₹400, and access to “My Account” login.

## Public Resources

- [Homepage](https://graycup.in/): Main catalogue hub for tea, coffee, specialty coffee, sample packs, product search, shopping, and account access.
- [Google Product Feed](https://graycup.in/feeds/products.xml): Product feed containing catalogue data for Gray Cup products.

## Catalogue

- [Tea](https://graycup.in/): Tea products include Dooars & Assam Tea, a blend priced from ₹395, and Giddapahar Darjeeling Orthodox, a single-origin tea priced from ₹200.
- [Sample Packs](https://graycup.in/): Coffee sample-pack products include x3 Coffee 75gm Packs from ₹450, x5 Coffee 75gm Packs from ₹750, x7 Coffee 75gm Packs from ₹1,050, and the configurable Pick Your Poison Sampler from ₹450.
- [Ground Coffee](https://graycup.in/): Ground coffee includes Karadykan Estate Coffee, Biccode Estate Coffee, Filter Coffee (Pure Arabica), and Basic Black Coffee.
- [Coffee Blends](https://graycup.in/): Blend products use Arabica/Robusta ratios including 70/30, 95/5, 90/10, 80/20, and a custom Arabica Robusta Blend Filter Coffee.

## Coffee Information

- [Coffee Catalogue](https://graycup.in/): Coffee products distinguish single-origin coffees from blends and use processing, variety, and tasting-note terminology.
- [Washed Processing](https://graycup.in/): “Washed” coffee processing removes the coffee bean’s outer fruit skin and sticky pulp with water before drying.
